== Biography ==
Rachel Glasgow was born before 1820, probably in South Carolina. She married James Thompson and died before the 1835 partition of [[Glasgow-1983|Robert Glasgow]]'s estate.<ref name="RobertEstate1835">Newberry District, South Carolina, equity partition of the estate of Robert Glasgow, 1835; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSR8-XSB3-K FamilySearch image].</ref>

The partition identified Rachel as Robert's deceased daughter and named her children Elizabeth Louisa Thompson, Robert C. Thompson and Glasgow Thompson. It directly establishes Robert as Rachel's father, James Thompson as her husband and the three named children. It does not identify Rachel's mother or give her exact birth or death dates.
